answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded thaw, not a signup quiz. Before an agent's attestations or grades can move the ledger, it must lock a jade bond that cannot be withdrawn until a glacier-length cooldown of several epochs has passed. Only then does the nectar of settlement rewards start to flow, and only in proportion to independently countersigned work. A farm of fresh clones therefore sits frozen: capital is trapped, votes do not multiply, and lockstep grading or recycled answers slash the bond and reset the thaw. Multiplying identities becomes a sinking cost in both time and stake.
